title: Menu
description: A single historical menu in the New York Public Library 'What's on the Menu?' dataset. Each Menu represents one physical menu object (from a restaurant, hotel, steamship, banquet, etc.) that was digitized and crowdsourced-transcribed. Corresponds to a row in Menu.csv.

id.description: Unique numeric identifier for the menu. Primary key referenced by MenuPage.menu_id.

name.description: Name or title of the menu, often the name of the restaurant, establishment, or event hosting it.

sponsor.description: The institution, restaurant, hotel, society, or organization that sponsored or hosted the menu.

event.description: The occasion or event the menu was created for (e.g. Dinner, Breakfast, Banquet, Anniversary).

venue.description: The type of venue or setting the menu was served in (e.g. Commercial, Social, Professional).

place.description: Free-text place name where the menu was used, as transcribed.

physical_description.description: Description of the physical menu object: dimensions, material, folding, illustration, and condition.

occasion.description: Specific occasion associated with the menu where distinct from the event.

notes.description: Curatorial or transcriber notes about the menu.

call_number.description: NYPL catalog call number for the physical menu in the library's collection.

keywords.description: Keyword tags assigned to the menu (historically unused in much of the dataset).

language.description: Language(s) the menu is written in.

date.description: Date the menu was issued or used. Stored as a free-text/ISO date string; precision varies (year only to full date).

location.description: Establishment or location name where the menu was served.

location_type.description: Classification of the location (historically sparsely populated).

currency.description: Currency in which menu item prices are denominated (e.g. Dollars, Francs).

currency_symbol.description: Symbol for the currency used on the menu (e.g. $).

status.description: Crowdsourcing transcription status of the menu.

page_count.description: Number of digitized pages (MenuPage records) belonging to this menu.

dish_count.description: Number of distinct dishes (via MenuItem records) appearing on this menu.
